title: HHHusher pinned features (v2)
description: A long cream section with the product pinned in the middle of the window (a sticky, window-tall stage) while four text panels scroll past it, about a window apart: the first in the left third (a big two-line heading up top, a small paragraph and buttons lower down), the rest in a narrow right-hand column. Headings rise in line by line, paragraphs fade in, and the stage fades up as the section arrives.
notes: the stage takes the 3D scene, a video or a cut-out picture; empty, it shows a soft placeholder panel where the object floats
about four windows tall: one panel per window
